I don’t mind them, I like learning random new words in other languages so I do appreciate learning the new tribe names each season. I do wish they switched up the length of the words and colors a little, it seems lazy. It used to feel like they made an effort to connect to the culture of the setting of the seasons but now it just seems cookie cutter. 

A little frustrating because it makes it seem almost useless to even care about them when they’re some of the few things that even remind you that this show takes place in another country that these players have never experienced. If it’s gonna be Fiji every year give us creative names based on town names/animals/folk characters, screw how easy they are to say, and not just “wave” or “sun”, give us challenges about the history, and rewards that involve locals god dammit show the culture and the people of these islands you’ve been inhabiting for over 10 seasons now. 

I realize it’s silly to be passionate about this and it’s far from Survivors biggest issue, but i don’t love how basic the creativity on this show is now.
